askHint: Larger trades wait for your approval. Closing a position never waits.

now.1: Agents suggest trades and nothing goes to OKX.
now.2: Every trade waits for your approval before it goes to OKX.
now.3: Trades up to {{amount}} go to OKX on their own. Larger ones, up to your {{largest}} limit, wait for you.
now.3all: Every trade goes to OKX on its own: your {{amount}} amount is above the largest trade your limits allow today, {{largest}}.
now.3zero: Every new trade waits for you. Only closing a position goes on its own.
now.4: Every trade goes to OKX on its own, up to your {{largest}} limit.

sh.title3: Let Atlas send trades without asking?
sh.title4: Let Atlas send every trade without asking?
sh.text3: At level 3, a trade the risk engine approves goes straight to OKX when it’s this size or smaller. You won’t see an approval card for it, only a notification when it fills.
sh.text4: At level 4, every trade the risk engine approves goes straight to OKX, whatever its size. So do closes and stop changes. You won’t see approval cards, only notifications.
sh.textRaise: Trades up to the new amount go straight to OKX, with no approval card.
sh.k1: Every trade passes the risk engine’s nine checks first.
sh.k2: Every order carries a stop-loss on OKX’s own servers.
sh.k3: Stop trading, on every page, halts it all at once.
sh.k4: While trading is paused, nothing is sent without you.
sh.onboarding: You can change this any time in Settings → Autonomy.

err.empty: Enter an amount. 0 means Atlas asks you about every new trade.
err.min: The ask-above amount must be 0 or more.

server.title: Couldn’t save
server.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer, so nothing changed. Try again.

conflict.title: Settings changed in another window
conflict.body: They were saved as version {{v}} while this sheet was open. Check the amount and confirm again.

refused.body: Nothing was saved. The level stays where it was.
